items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And I’ve got a great wife, Patricia.

ctx.x: Yeah somehow it didn’t work out with school and then he started playing right away.

Yeah, oh that’s great. Well I work in New York but as soon as I’m done I drive back home 20 miles away I’m in a very residential area, a beautiful little town, Oradell, New Jersey. And I’ve got a great wife, Patricia. She helps me all the time you know.

So Ronnie, I was looking this morning at the top ten from different years, and if my calculations are right when you were ten years old the top singers in the music were Perry Como, Frankie Laine, Dinah Shore. Okay. Six years later “Cherry Pink and Apple Blossom White,” “Rock Around the Clock,” “The Yellow Rose of Texas.” So my question is, what on the radio, if anything, grabbed you at that time, when you were like impressionable?
